source_en: Pavle Asatiani. Butcher, end of the market row. Don't stare at the face.
The bandages bother you? They bother me more. Ask, if you have to.

es-ES: ¿Qué te ha pasado en la cara?
pt-BR: O que aconteceu com o seu rosto?
de: Was ist mit Ihrem Gesicht geschehen?
ja-JP: その顔はどうしたんだ？
pl: Co ci się stało z twarzą?

source_en: Meat grinder. You don't feel it until an hour later.
Not here. You'd lose your appetite, and you look underfed already.
My brother's old stall. Ration meat, mostly. Nobody asks what animal.
He cried for a week before he left. Now I'm [[whisper:the one wearing it]].
Whatever comes in. Keep asking like that and you'll outlast the last one.

ru: Документы. Все хорошо. По большей части.
fr: Les papiers. Tout est en ordre. À peu près.
es-ES: Los papeles. Todo está en orden. Más o menos.
pt-BR: Documentos. Está tudo em ordem. Quase tudo.
ja-JP: 書類です。問題はありませんよ。ほぼ、ですけど。
ko-KR: 서류요. 모든 게 맞게 되어 있지. 대부분은.
